settings_static_016.message: [GB] Pick a category to change how KeyPilot looks and behaves. Use the list on the left anytime.

settings_static_022.message: [GB] Built-in packs restyle chrome, type, and icons. Edits live on the Appearance tab. Choosing a theme also applies that theme’s Click Mode and cursor defaults.

settings_static_024.message: [GB] Theme pack, window corners, titlebar, keycaps, colors, and type size.

settings_static_026.message: [GB] Layout family, left-handed variant, and floating keyboard reference options.

settings_static_028.message: [GB] Hover focus rectangle, link-hover hints, and click activation effects.

settings_static_030.message: [GB] Text-field cursor, focus style, labels, and outline thickness.

settings_static_032.message: [GB] C / V distance, smooth vs instant, Scroll Line targeting, and middle-click.

settings_static_034.message: [GB] Custom cursors on/off, plus Click Mode crosshair type and geometry.

settings_static_036.message: [GB] Show or hide the status strip, and whether it starts collapsed.

settings_static_038.message: [GB] Search engine for the New Tab box and KeyPilot’s omnibox (Alt+L).

settings_static_040.message: [GB] Where settings are stored, how they sync, and optional debug logging.

settings_static_042.message: [GB] Restore all KeyPilot settings to product defaults (appearance, Click Mode, keyboard, scrolling, stored panel positions, and the rest).

settings_static_045.message: [GB] Customize the selected built-in theme. Changes apply immediately and stay with that pack until you reset or switch themes.

settings_static_051.message: [GB] Switching packs starts from that theme’s defaults (custom edits are cleared). Click Mode defaults follow the pack.

settings_static_057.message: [GB] Corner cut depth in pixels (0–24). Used when Corner style is Cut.

settings_static_059.message: [GB] Rounded corner radius in pixels (0–24). Used when Corner style is Rounded.

settings_static_083.message: [GB] Key corner cut depth in pixels (0–16). Used when Key corners is Cut.

settings_static_097.message: [GB] Base UI font size in pixels (9–18).

settings_static_099.message: [GB] Keyboard key label font size in pixels (8–16).

settings_static_101.message: [GB] Clear token edits and restore the selected built-in theme. Click Mode is left as-is.

settings_static_104.message: [GB] Used by the New Tab search box and KeyPilot’s omnibox (Alt+L).

settings_static_109.message: [GB] Layout and floating keyboard reference panel behavior.

settings_static_114.message: [GB] Controls which built-in layout family is active. Handedness is set separately so cycling families never flips left/right.

settings_static_116.message: [GB] Use the left-handed variant of the selected layout family (shortcuts primarily on the right side).

settings_static_118.message: [GB] Include the 1–0 row in the floating keyboard reference panel and layout editor.

settings_static_120.message: [GB] Highlights keys in the floating keyboard reference panel on keydown/keyup.

settings_static_122.message: [GB] Whether KeyPilot overrides the page cursor, plus Click Mode cursor style and geometry.

settings_static_126.message: [GB] When “No Custom Cursors” is selected, KeyPilot won’t override the page cursor and the Click Mode cursor controls below are hidden. “KeyPilot Cursors” shows KeyPilot’s crosshair (and related) cursors instead.

settings_static_136.message: [GB] Size of the cursor in pixels (5–60px).

settings_static_138.message: [GB] Gap between center and crosshair bars in pixels. 0 = intersecting lines, >0 = separate bars (0–20px).

settings_static_141.message: [GB] Keyboard page scrolling for C / V (smaller step). Z / X jump to the edge. Scroll Line targeting and optional middle-click.

settings_static_143.message: [GB] Pixels scrolled by C (up) and V (down). Default 500.

settings_static_147.message: [GB] Animation for keyboard scrolling (C/V, Z/X, B/N).

settings_static_148.message: [GB] Scroll Line skips wide in-page scrollers

settings_static_149.message: [GB] Skip horizontal carousels so Scroll Line locks the page or a vertical pane. Full-width vertical columns still scroll even when the box is landscape.

settings_static_151.message: [GB] On empty page area, the middle mouse button runs the Scroll Line action (same as the bound key). Links, clickables, and text fields keep native middle-click. On by default on Mac.

settings_static_154.message: [GB] Hover focus rectangle, keyboard hints, and click activation effects.

settings_static_156.message: [GB] Live hover outline on clickable targets. Changes apply immediately (including in this Settings window).

settings_static_160.message: [GB] Outline color for the focus rectangle.

settings_static_162.message: [GB] Adds a translucent fill inside the focus rectangle.

settings_static_164.message: [GB] Soft outer glow around the focus rectangle.

settings_static_166.message: [GB] Border thickness for the focus rectangle (1–16px).

settings_static_168.message: [GB] Glow keys when hovering a link

settings_static_169.message: [GB] While the Keyboard Reference is open, matching green action keys get an outline and glow when you hover a clickable link on the page. Off by default.

settings_static_174.message: [GB] Dashed border marches around the edge

settings_static_176.message: [GB] Solid light travels around the border

settings_static_182.message: [GB] Paint backend, parent skip, debug borders, and focus-ring padding

settings_static_188.message: [GB] Nested controls that share the parent’s destination (same URL, data-href, inline onclick, the same click listener, or a parent row/card click such as Gmail) use the parent’s hover ring. Buttons and other destinations keep their own. On by default.

settings_static_190.message: [GB] Dashes A / B / C differently so you can tell which backend painted the hover ring (A dashed, B dotted, C double). Off by default.

settings_static_192.message: [GB] Outward gap around the focus rectangle (0–16px). Default 2px matches the old outline offset; B→C rings previously used 0.

settings_static_195.message: [GB] Cursor + focus style + labels for text fields.

settings_static_203.message:
[GB] How the active text field looks while typing (text mode). Hover still shows an orange outline
                and “F to select” to the left of the field.

settings_static_205.message: [GB] Orange bar on the left edge, pulsing (default). “Esc to exit” sits to the left of the bar.

settings_static_207.message: [GB] Full orange wash over the field (previous style), plus the Esc hint.

settings_static_209.message: [GB] Width of the pulsating left-edge bar (1–24px). Default 5px.

settings_static_211.message: [GB] Show labels above and below focused text field

settings_static_212.message: [GB] Shows “Active text field” and “Press ESC to close”. Turn off for outline-only.

settings_static_214.message: [GB] Thickness of the orange text-mode outlines (1–16px).

settings_static_218.message: [GB] When off, the strip is hidden until you enable this or press Alt+J to toggle it back on.

settings_static_220.message: [GB] Shows only the On/Off status segment until you expand the strip.

settings_static_222.message: [GB] KeyPilot settings sync via Chrome profile storage.

settings_static_225.message: [GB] Off by default. When on, KeyPilot writes verbose console messages in the service worker and page consoles. Leave off for store/release builds.

settings_static_227.message: [GB] Video previews may send a video URL or ID to its provider to load a thumbnail.

settings_firefox_thumbnails_granted_stat.message: [GB] Consent granted for video thumbnail lookups.

settings_firefox_thumbnails_pending_stat.message: [GB] Video thumbnails stay off until you enable them.
